title: Until We Return — interactive work surfaces
provenance: Seven individual OpenAI ImageGen redraws of project-owned reference paintings. Each source PNG preserves the generated output bytes. The reference SHA-256 entry identifies the earlier painting used for registration. Objects and working details are staged reconstructions for play.
coordinate_system: Percentages of the full uncropped 3:2 image. Point arrays are [x, y] measured from the upper left.

assets.caption: Sea chest in the salvage
assets.prompt:
Redraw this supplied original game painting from scratch as a visibly new, finely illustrated maritime naturalist plate for an 1860s South Pacific castaway adventure. The reference is a registered underdrawing: keep full original 3:2 landscape crop, perspective, object scale, silhouette edges and important landmarks at the very same pixels. Express a much more crafted hand: selective graphite contours, broken umber ink, fine cross-hatching drawn with the grain, scumbled opaque gouache, muted slate and blue-black shadows against flax, rust red and warm honey wood. Stronger directional low glancing light carves volumes. Make a convincing nineteenth-century close observation of a real working object with areas of luminous pigment and breathing room. Deliver a full-bleed single illustration, no frame, margin, captions, lettering, icons, annotations, people, new equipment, sepia photographic filter or UI. Do not change viewpoint. Positions below are exact percentages x from left,y from top.

Weathered wreck-salvaged chest, impression of wet cold dawn. The nearly horizontal lid seam is at y60% crossing x20 and strap at x38. The small fingertip triangular missing splinter and its black purchase MUST sit precisely x73.5,y60. Far right iron band is cropped at x97.5. Preserve small upper-left wedge of sea and worn folded canvas at top. Render hand adze cuts, grain curl, iron slag and rivet shadows in contrasting gunmetal, pale timber and rusty umber. No bar, added hardware, lifted lid or gaping joint.
